description: This file is a shell script for managing git submodules, including adding, initializing, updating, listing, and configuring submodules. It defines multiple functions for submodule operations and parses command-line arguments to dispatch commands.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the working tree, .gitmodules, and the index.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes an arbitrary command in each checked out submodule.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules from .git/config and removes their work trees.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule to the correct revision, using clone and checkout as needed.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows commit summaries for submodules in index or working tree.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules with their status, indicating uninitialized or different revision checked out.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Syncs remote URLs for submodules to match .gitmodules.
